notes: Qwen-Image 2.1 (int8), text-to-image. Converted from the official image_qwen_image_2_1_t2i.json template (its promoted-widget subgraph expanded - see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): UNETLoader/CLIPLoader/VAELoader load the three real files (qwen_image_2.1_int8_convrot.safetensors, qwen3vl_8b_int8_convrot.safetensors, qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16.safetensors), not a single checkpoint, so unet_name/clip_name/vae_name are ordinary editable parameters (like flux_kontext_edit's) rather than going through the single-checkpoint cross-check sdxl/flux_schnell/ace15_song get - a missing file is still caught before queueing (validate_against_object_info) and reported as 'download it', never a crash. The official template's ResolutionSelector (aspect-ratio preset + megapixel budget) is replaced by direct, editable width/height on EmptyLatentImage so callers can set an exact size (multiples of 16; presets: 1:1 1024x1024, 16:9 1344x768 or 1920x1088, 4:5 1024x1280, 9:16 768x1344, 2K 2048x2048 - native 2K is supported at higher VRAM/time cost). `resolution` is TextEncodeQwenImage21's own pixel-budget widget (unrelated to output size): kept at its default. `negative_prompt` defaults to empty like the official template; Qwen-Image 2.1 has strong prompt adherence and renders in-image typography well, so exact text belongs in the prompt when wanted.
